text.description_html:
Deltana DSH45U32D, 4.5" x 4.5" Square Corners Stainless Steel Spring Hinge

The 4.5 x 4.5 Stainless Steel Spring Hinge comes packaged complete with one (1) single action stainless steel spring door hinge, tension adjusting allen wrench, adjusting pin, locking pin, plus the mounting hardware. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes). The included Allen Wrench Tool is used to adjust spring tension while the Locking Pin holds the spring in tension after it is set to the desired closing force.

Specifications for the Deltana DSH44U32D Stainless Steel Spring Hinge:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.136"
  • Certified: R19063 UL Listed Door Closer Body 57YM
  • Stainless Steel Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Stainless Steel Machine Screws: #12 x 1/2"
  • Deltana DSH45U32D Hinge Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually--one (1) spring door hinge.
